title: dreams and life lol
content: just as food for thought or discussion vibes (idk if this is allowed bc it’s not necessarily a specific spot relevant to the collective, tho my dads house[variation] is a common nightmare spot for me to to this day lmao): when i was young, like 11-13, i had a dream that my father had a shot gun and in front of his house he used it and shot me in the back. i fell forward into the grass. and my siblings (half and step) circled me as i lay bleeding out in the front yard. i cried and begged for help but they just stared emotionless. then my dad shot me again and i like sprung awake, shocked. at this time i had no reason to feel this way. fast forward to me at 22 and my dad and i have a terrible falling out, and also lost connection with my siblings. i mean a HUGE fight in the front yard. screaming yelling a truck running over the yard… as i healed from my young years, many nightmares and dreams have really stuck with me. oddly enough (im boutta be 28 this year ugh) . i don’t share it much bc it feels so stupid lol “oh my dream my dream”. but this one feels very very metaphoric. yet again i feel the universe has a sort of comedic irony to it. lol thanks for reading 🙏
